verdict.rationale: Lovable offers some separation mechanisms — 'drafts' give collaborators independent copies with their own chat/preview, 'remixing' creates an independent copy, and Git sync lets you 'test features on branches' before deploying — but nothing in the docs explicitly describes a sandbox environment isolated from production data (e.g., a staging database or test data separate from the live Cloud backend). Publishing docs only describe deploying a snapshot, not a distinct sandbox tier. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment concept, separation of test data from production database, first-party or independent confirmation that testing in a draft/branch does not touch production data.
